title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
short: Traditional (French tune, 1761; words by · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: The first piece for both hands. The left hand plays one slow note while the right hand sings the tune. Play each hand alone first, then put them together slowly. In the first line your right hand sits a little higher: thumb on C, finger 4 on G and finger 5 on A.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: The French song “Ah! vous dirai-je, maman” with the English poem “The Star”

sources.name: Melody checked against the theme of Mozart’s Variations on “Ah vous dirai-je, maman”, K. 265 (Mutopia Project edition for two guitars, from the Porro print; public domain). The notes match. Mozart repeats the note on the long words (“star”, “are”) and adds two small decorations (bars 7 and 15); the song as sung holds a half note there instead. Dates from Wikipedia.
